{{Quote|Xim&mdash;I am wedded to you by the lance, forged by the craftiest of all Duin smiths, its handle twined in Raxan seaweed, its vamplate a kiirium mirror like my mail, its shaft a stake for slugs and all their slime, its barb sprinkled with malkite, a deathknell to all who would poison our union.|An excerpt from ''The Gleam of Kiirium'' by Asenec of Crakull|<ref name="EGtW:AC" />}}
'''Raxan seaweed''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Seaweed/Legends|seaweed]]. In [[Gender/Legends|his]] poem about the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] despot [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], ''[[The Gleam of Kiirium]]'' the [[Croke]] [[Poet/Legends|poet]] [[Asenec]] made mention of the seaweed. The [[Unidentified Duinarbulon Star Lancer|character]] from whose perspective the poem is told, a [[Duinarbulon Star Lancers|Duinarbulon Star Lancer]], describes their [[Lance/Legends|lance]] as having a handle wrapped in the [[Plant/Legends|plant]].<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Raxan seaweed supposed to be first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2012]] written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], but they were ultimately cut from the final product. The section including Raxan seaweed was later published as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] starting in [[2013]].
